Don't ever buy any equipments from this person. I have bought many Solar equipments from him. His service is horrible. I had a problem with my Solar Heater bought from him. 12 days back I had leakage problem. I complained to him. He asked to send video & pics. Next day I asked when he will attend to the problem. He said he didn't get my video, though I sent and whatsapp showed as delivered...
Till today (12days) he has not even come to see the equipment. Problem still not attended. Even though I invested in a solar heater, I'm forced to have bath in freezing cold water, during this winter time and he is absolutely not bothered to carry out the repairs....
PLEASE NEVER BUY ANY SOLAR EQUIPMENTS, FROM THIS SUPPLIER........

I had opted for Solar operated motor pump solution from Jaisrie Marketing for my new farm. It's been almost a year and the plants in the farm has come up well using ONLY the Solar solution provided by Jaisrie Marketing. We don't have an EB connection at our farm and the Solar solution works perfectly fine.
Thank you Jaisrie Marketing.
